headline: Computer Engineering @ UCLA
description: Hi! I'm a Computer Engineering student at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), expected to graduate in Spring 2027. Through research, hackathons, and internships, I've developed solutions in healthcare, developer tooling, and data-driven applications. I enjoy tackling complex problems and translating ideas into scalable, efficient solutions. My goal is to leverage my skills in software engineering to build impactful solutions that drive lasting, positive change.
footnote: I am currently looking for 2027 new grad opportunities! Currently based in Los Angeles, with a preference for the Bay Area and open to relocation.
